name: kit-pet
description: A small original pixel pet in a band above the prompt: it reacts to what Claude does (working, done, error, low quota), grows as you finish turns, and cheers your first milestones. Three pets, English and Vietnamese, no setup.

showPet.title: Show the pet
showPet.description: Turn off to hide the pet. Your growth and achievements are still counted.

pet.title: Which pet
pet.description: moss: Moss, a leafy moss ball. bun: Bun, a steamed bun with a fold. jelly: Jelly, a little jellyfish. Anything else shows Moss.

achievements.title: Achievement toasts
achievements.description: A short toast for a 7-day streak, 100 finished turns, your first green test run and your first commit, at most one per day. Off: no toasts.

language.title: Language of the band and toasts
language.description: auto: Vietnamese when Claude Code's own language setting is Vietnamese, English otherwise. en: always English. vi: always Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt).
